newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat plans to visit Jordan next week.
newsitem.headline: Arafat plans to visit Jordan next week.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat plans to visit Jordan next week for talks on Middle East peace efforts, an aide said.
Arafat's media advisor Nabil Abu Rdainah told reporters the visit would take place early next week after the king returns from England. He gave no specific date.
"The visit is part of the ongoing consultations between the two countries," Abu Rdainah said late on Thursday.

Palestinian media said on Friday Arafat spoke with King Hussein by telephone Thursday night from the West Bank town of Ramallah to brief him on the status of U.S.-brokered Palestinian-Israeli talks on implementing self-rule deals signed last year.

The two men last met at a White House crisis summit called by U.S. President Bill Clinton to salvage American peacemaking efforts threatened by fierce Israeli-Palestinian clashes that killed 75 in September.
